title: BIR Revenue Memorandum Circular No. 47-2026: Closure and/or Cancellation of Business Registration
note: Controlling rule. The file contains the BIR Digest text (digest PDF: https://bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/BIR/pdf/RMC%20No.%2047-2026%20Digest.pdf), which numbers the requirements with letters, plus OCR-verified excerpts of Sections 3 to 7 of the scanned full text, which number them 1 to 5. Quotes cite the OCR-verified excerpts. Where the Citizen's Charter 28-A disagrees (ending inventory, audit thresholds), RMC 47-2026 is later and controls.

title: BIR Citizen's Charter (2026 Edition), 28-A: Application for Closure of Business, Head Office Not Subject to Audit
note: Text extracted from the PDF text layer. Published before RMC 47-2026, so its audit thresholds and its ending-inventory requirement (no VAT qualifier) are superseded by RMC 47-2026.

title: BIR Revenue Memorandum Circular No. 84-2026: One-Time Abatement for Micro Taxpayers (Digest)
note: BIR Digest text extracted from the PDF text layer. Clarifies RR No. 004-2026, the one-time abatement program for micro taxpayers; applications are timely if filed on or before 2026-12-31.
